mode.title: Mode
mode.description: backfill: rebuild the baseline for a date range. daily: add yesterday to the baseline (schedule once a day, just after midnight UTC). news: sweep MarketWatch and Yahoo news only (schedule every 2 hours, the feeds are rolling windows). live: D-day snapshot of the last N minutes for X, Threads, news and quotes (schedule every 15 minutes). rescore: no scraping; re-scores posts already saved in the <storeName>-posts dataset for the date range and rebuilds those days.

dateFrom.title: From date (UTC)
dateFrom.description: First day to collect in backfill or daily mode, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 2026-11-05 for backfill and yesterday for daily.

dateTo.title: To date (UTC)
dateTo.description: Last day to collect, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to yesterday.

xQuery.title: X search query
xQuery.description: One X advanced-search query for xquik/x-tweet-scraper. The Actor adds since_time:/until_time: per time slice.
xQuery.default: Anthropic (IPO OR stock OR shares OR valuation OR $ANT) -filter:retweets

searchQueries.title: LinkedIn, YouTube and Threads search terms
searchQueries.description: Search terms passed to the LinkedIn, YouTube and Threads Actors.

liveTicker.title: Main ticker
liveTicker.description: The ticker the tracker is about. Use another listed ticker (for example NVDA) to rehearse D-day.

peerTickers.title: Peer tickers
peerTickers.description: Quoted next to the main ticker and used to find Anthropic stories on Yahoo Finance.

llmModel.title: Sentiment model (OpenRouter)
llmModel.description: Model id used through the Apify OpenRouter Actor to score each post.

maxXTweetsPerDay.title: Max X tweets per day
maxXTweetsPerDay.description: Backfill and daily mode. Each day is split into four 6-hour slices so the sample covers the whole day. About $0.15 per 1,000 tweets. When a slice hits its share, that day is flagged as a floor.

maxXTweetsLive.title: Max X tweets per live snapshot
maxXTweetsLive.description: Live mode: every tweet from the live window, up to this many.

maxLinkedInPostsPerQuery.title: Max LinkedIn posts per query per day
maxLinkedInPostsPerQuery.description: Multiplied by the number of days in the range.

maxYouTubeVideosPerQuery.title: Max YouTube videos per query per day
maxYouTubeVideosPerQuery.description: Multiplied by the number of days in the range (up to 4).

maxThreadsPostsPerQuery.title: Max Threads posts per query per day
maxThreadsPostsPerQuery.description: Threads keyword search (lergassy/threads-scraper), about $0.0018 per post. Multiplied by the number of days in the range (up to 4).

maxThreadsPostsLive.title: Max Threads posts per query per live snapshot
maxThreadsPostsLive.description: Live mode. Threads shows logged-out visitors 20 to 60 posts per keyword, so a small number is enough.

maxScoredPerPlatformDay.title: Max posts scored per platform per day
maxScoredPerPlatformDay.description: LLM sentiment sample per platform per UTC day: the most-engaged third plus an even spread of the rest. Volume still counts every collected post, scaled by the relevance rate of the sample.

liveWindowMinutes.title: Live window (minutes)
liveWindowMinutes.description: In live mode, how far back the snapshot looks. Keep it equal to the schedule interval (15 min) so snapshots do not overlap.

storeName.title: Storage name
storeName.description: Name of the key-value store (and the <name>-posts dataset) the website reads.
